code.originalText: Blood pressure, nutrition, vitamin B12 and D, and bone health review at about five months

text.paragraph: Blood pressure, nutrition, vitamin B12 and D, and bone health review. [S]

Mr. Gandhi returns about three months after refeeding. He reached full intake on the seventh day of refeeding and finished the supplements as planned. The repeat phosphate, potassium, and magnesium planned for three to four days after his last visit were not drawn; the order was placed but no appointment was booked. He has had no swelling, palpitations, or weakness. In June he had a near-fall from dehydration in hot weather; amlodipine was held for two days and restarted, and he now drinks more in the heat. His home blood pressure averages 126/74. He walks 5 km each morning again. His weight is back to 46.0 kg. He takes vitamin B12 and D daily and, with the dietitian, has added curd, dal, and a handful of groundnuts each day; his food record shows about 52 g of protein a day. [S]
